name: Toggle
purpose: A switch that turns a single setting on or off with immediate effect (dark mode, notifications, sound). Uses the ARIA switch pattern on web and the platform Switch on native.

props.name: label
props.description: What the switch controls. Phrase as the 'on' state ('Sound effects').

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: start puts the label first and the switch at the far end (settings lists).

states.name: off
states.description: Neutral track, thumb at start with a dash glyph.

states.name: on
states.description: Brand track, thumb at end with a check glyph.

accessibility.role: switch (<button role=switch aria-checked>) / native Switch with accessibilityRole="switch"
accessibility.touchTarget: Track plus an invisible extension to 44px tall on touch; clicking the label toggles too.
notes: State is shown by thumb position and glyph, not only color (1.4.1).

do: Apply the change immediately when toggled.
Keep labels short and stable — don't change the label text when toggled.
dont: Don't use inside a form that needs a Submit button — use Checkbox.
Don't use for choices that aren't on/off (e.g. 'Grid / List') — use Tabs or RadioGroup.

example.web:
<Toggle label="Sound effects" defaultChecked onCheckedChange={setSound} />
<Toggle label="Dark mode" labelPosition="start" checked={dark} onCheckedChange={(on) => setColorMode(on ? 'dark' : 'light')} />
